mapper.sql: select s.slot_id, s.user_id, u.nick_name as consultant_name, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.mode, s.status, s.booking_id, s.create_by, s.create_time from abr_consult_slot s left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id
mapper.select: where s.status = 'open' and s.start_time >= #{from} and s.start_time < #{to} and s.end_time >= s.start_time + make_interval(mins => #{minutes}) and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' order by s.start_time, s.user_id limit 500
mapper.insert: insert into abr_consult_slot (user_id, start_time, end_time, mode, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{mode}, 'open', #{createBy}, now(), #{createBy}, now()) on conflict (user_id, start_time) do nothing
mapper.update: update abr_consult_slot set status = 'booked', booking_id = #{bookingId}, update_time = now() where slot_id = #{slotId} and status = 'open'
update abr_consult_slot set status = 'open', booking_id = null, update_time = now() where slot_id = #{slotId} and booking_id = #{bookingId} and status = 'booked'
mapper.delete: delete from abr_consult_slot where status in ('open', 'closed') and booking_id is null and slot_id in #{id}
